newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-VAN DER WESTHUIZEN TO CAPTAIN SEVENS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-VAN DER WESTHUIZEN TO CAPTAIN SEVENS.

text.p: Springbok scrum half Joost van der Westhuizen was named late on Friday as captain of a strong South African sevens squad to compete in the sevens world cup in Hong Kong from March 21-23.

Van der Westhuizen takes over from loose forward Dion O'Cuinneagain, dropped from the squad after three years as captain. Coach Dawie Syman picked burly Transvaal centre Japie Mulder as an extra loose forward.

Two outstanding coloured players were selected on the wings in Breyton Paulse and Jeffrey Stevens, both from the Cape and aged just 20 and 19 respectively. Both lack the weight to make telling tackles but their speed and finishing skills could still mke them the stars of the tournament for South Africa.
The only player likely to have made the squad but who was unavailable through injury was Springbok fullback Andre Joubert who recently underwent groin surgery.
Squad: Steven Brink, Japie Mulder, Breyton Paulse Pieter Rossouw, Bobby Skinstad, Jeffrey Stevens, Joost van der Westhuizen, Ande Venter, Peet Arnold.
